purpose: Provide an executable validator for finite-mesh boundary-target rho_E transition tables on the candidate Iwasawa finite-element cell.

supported_format_v1.mesh_N: positive integer subdivision parameter for the closed cell {0,...,N}^6
supported_format_v1.generator_data: g1..g6 must each contain either a constant 3x3 matrix or a values table keyed by x1,x2,y1,y2,t1,t2
supported_format_v1.complex_entry: matrix entries are either real numbers or [real, imag]
supported_format_v1.constant_fallback: a generator may supply matrix plus values overrides; values at a boundary target override the constant fallback
supported_format_v1.absorbed_word_convention: central wraps or deck-word choices must already be absorbed into the supplied face-transition value

script_exit_codes.0: complete finite-mesh candidate passes implemented checks
script_exit_codes.1: complete finite-mesh candidate fails an implemented algebraic or schema check
script_exit_codes.2: candidate is incomplete/open, such as the template with null generator entries or missing mesh_N

verdict.next_step: Fill a selected finite-mesh or symbolic rho_E candidate, run both constant and mesh validators as applicable, then add Hermitian metric and sector-projection validators before assembling D_E.
